backend/main.mo: Main backend actor with product management, shopping cart, user profiles, branding configuration, Stripe integration, and access control. Includes inventory management with increment/decrement functions and admin-only product operations.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old product and cart data structures (with categories) to new structures (without categories, adding inventoryCount field set to 0).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the inventory increment button feature in ProductManagementTable component with high confidence and test ID REQ-38.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend components, pages, and hooks, noting removal of category-related functionality after backend migration and addition of useIncrementInventory hook.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, defining colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, title 'Artisan Hub', root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component setting up TanStack Router with all routes (marketplace, dashboard, basket, checkout, payment, legal pages), ThemeProvider, dynamic branding hook, and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin branding configuration form component for updating site name, logo, and favicon with file upload, preview, progress tracking, and integration with backend branding API.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Component for bulk uploading multiple products with image files, allowing users to set product details (name, description, shape, price, inventory) with auto-copy functionality and AI-generated descriptions. Handles file uploads, progress tracking, and batch product creation via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying site branding, navigation links to legal pages (Terms & Privacy Policy), and attribution link to caffeine.ai. Uses TanStack Router for navigation and displays current year dynamically.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component with sticky header containing site logo/branding, authentication controls, navigation to basket/dashboard, and cart item count badge. Includes ProfileSetupModal for new users and Footer component.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Card component displaying individual product with image, name, shape, price, and 'Add to Basket' button. Handles adding items to cart with loading states and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog showing detailed product view with large image, full description, price, and action buttons for 'Add to Basket' and 'Buy Now'. Buy Now redirects to checkout with product ID stored in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table component for managing products with inline editing of name, shape, and price fields, image replacement upload functionality, and inventory increment controls. Includes validation, loading states, and toast notifications for all operations.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup requiring name and email input. Cannot be dismissed and blocks interaction until profile is created via mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: React component that provides a form for configuring Stripe payment settings, including secret key and allowed countries list.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance with authentication, creating actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Custom hook that dynamically updates the document title and favicon based on branding configuration fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, products, cart items, Stripe configuration, and branding settings.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, earthy color palette (terracotta, cream, sage) for light and dark themes with artisan aesthetic.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page component that handles both single product and cart checkout flows, collecting shipping information and creating Stripe checkout sessions.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays product statistics, manages products via tabs (manage, bulk upload, settings, branding), and enforces admin-only access with Stripe configuration requirement.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Public marketplace page displaying a hero banner and product grid with clickable cards that open a detailed product view modal.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page showing an error message with options to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success confirmation page that clears the cart and buyNow session data, displaying a success message with a continue shopping button.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Static privacy policy page displaying information collection, usage, sharing, security, user rights, cookies, and contact details in a formatted card layout.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Shopping cart page displaying cart items with quantity controls, remove buttons, and a checkout summary with total price and proceed-to-checkout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Static terms and conditions page covering product information, pricing, shipping, returns, intellectual property, liability, and policy changes in a formatted card layout.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, typography with Inter and Crimson Pro fonts, custom shadows, accordion animations, and container settings with responsive breakpoints.
project_state.json: Project state document for Artisan Hub marketplace defining architecture (Stripe integration, bulk upload, shopping basket), known issues (image persistence failure, Buy Now redirect bug), and existing features including product management, checkout flow, and public storefront.
